paras: Application: Ford Focus ST 2013+ Part Type: Sound symposer block-off kit Part Number: 20-0356

The Radium Sound Symposer Block-Off replaces the OEM sound symposer, which pipes engine sound into the cabin and serves no purpose once engine modifications are made. Removing it frees up space in the engine bay.
hl: Symposer Delete: Replaces the OEM sound symposer system
Quick Install: No cutting or drilling required
Vacuum Reference Option: 1/8" NPT port can be plugged or used as a vacuum source
OEM Gasket Reuse: Designed to reuse the OEM Ford gasket
Billet Construction: Billet aluminium plate and fittings
ft: Radium Engineering Sound Symposer Delete kit for Ford Focus ST LW/LZ 2011-2018
